description.en: Add, edit, enable and test MCP servers from the Web settings page or from eight mcp_manager_* agent tools. It connects and disconnects stdio and Streamable HTTP servers at runtime through the harness's own MCP bridge, so no DSH restart is needed.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置页或通过 8 个 mcp_manager_* Agent 工具增删改查 MCP 服务器。它通过 harness 自带的 MCP 桥在运行时连接与断开 stdio / Streamable HTTP 服务器，不需要重启 DSH。
